subject: Post-demo recap: buying roles checklist + canary deployment ask
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@retailinc.com>, Carlos Mendoza <carlos.mendoza@retailinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap: buying roles checklist + canary deployment ask

Hi Elena / Carlos —

Thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Roles & timeline: we captured the likely economic buyer (Carlos M.), security reviewer (Elena), and procurement contact (procurement@retailinc.com). Can you confirm those are correct and who else should be on the steering call?

2) Decision criteria: you mentioned latency SLA (p95 < 200ms), isolation for PII, and a one-month pilot with representative traffic. We'll draft those into the evaluation checklist.

3) Canary deployment ask: to demonstrate risk-minimized rollout we propose a controlled canary (2% traffic) on Redwood Dedicated for the pilot. That helps validate cost and latency without touching core production.

4) Procurement path: to speed procurement, attached is a procurement checklist we commonly share — it maps the legal + security artifacts we provide and typical timelines.

Next steps (proposed):
- Elena: confirm steering committee attendees and two 60-minute windows next week for an exec sponsor sync.
- Carlos: confirm economic buyer and if finance needs a separate call.
- Procurement: review attached checklist and flag any missing docs.
- Ben/Marissa (Redwood): we'll prepare a short one-pager with pilot scope, timeline, and a draft SOW stub for initial review.

Attaching: Redwood_RetailInc_post-demo-checklist.pdf; procurement-checklist-retailinc.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@retailinc.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendoza <carlos.mendoza@retailinc.com>, procurement@retailinc.com
Date: 2027-08-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: buying roles checklist + canary deployment ask

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming roles: Carlos is our VP of Product and will be the economic owner; I will own security review; procurement@retailinc.com is the procurement inbox (Ana from our procurement team will pick up). 

Steering committee attendees I'd like to see on the initial sync: Carlos (econ), myself (security), Ana (procurement), and one engineering lead (TBD). Two good windows next week are: Tuesday 9/1 10:00–11:00 PT or Thursday 9/3 14:00–15:00 PT.

We are open to the canary approach — please include expected KPIs for the canary (latency p95, error rate, token cost delta) in the pilot SOW.

I'll ask Ana to review your procurement checklist and reply with any additional docs we require.

Regards,
Elena
Director, Cloud Security
RetailInc

Elena / Ana —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple notes from the sales/procurement side to help structure internal approvals: 

- Procurement docs: we'll surface SOC 2 Type II report, our standard DPA, network diagram, and an audited data flow. Marissa is looped for legal redline support.
- Commercial approach: for the month-long pilot we typically do a usage credit + short commitment for Dedicated capacity if you need predictable throughput during the canary. I can draft two pricing options (credit vs small committed baseline) for your finance team.
- Can we get a rough target for pilot traffic (requests/minute or tokens/day) so engineering can size the canary?

Action items:
- Ana / procurement: please tell us which contract template you prefer (our MSA or your purchasing agreement) and any PO requirements.
- Kimberly & Marissa: we'll prep the SOW draft and a short one-pager on canary KPIs.

Thanks — I'll hold off on sending formal pricing until we hear from procurement on the template.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: procurement@retailinc.com <procurement@retailinc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@retailinc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: buying roles checklist + canary deployment ask

Hi Ben / Kimberly —

Thanks for the checklist. We typically prefer to start with our PO template and attach a short SOW; however, we can accept a Redwood MSA with our standard amendments. A few procurement asks up front so we can calendar faster: 

- Please supply a single-page pricing summary + any proposed credit terms.
- Confirm insurance limits (we require 1M per occurrence, 3M aggregate).
- Provide an estimated calendar for contract negotiation (roughly how many review cycles you expect).
- For pilot sizing: we anticipate 400–600 avg requests/minute during peak for the use case we showed.

We will review the procurement-checklist-retailinc.xlsx you attached and revert with any additional items by EOD 9/2.

Regards,
RetailInc Procurement Team (Ana)
procurement@retailinc.com

Hi Ana / Procurement team —

Thanks for the sizing estimate — that helps a lot. A few legal/ops clarifications we can provide quickly: 

- Insurance: Redwood carries $2M per occurrence and $5M aggregate; we'll attach our certificate and insurer contact.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II, penetration test summary, and our network diagram are available. We'll place them in the Drive link Kimberly included and share direct access.
- Contract cadence: typical review is 2–3 cycles for similar customers; if you send your PO template now we can slot legal review and aim to have an executed PO + SOW within 3 weeks from signature intent.

Marissa will attach the certificate and a draft SOW (pilot scope + canary KPI table). Kim / Ben: we'll produce the one-page pricing summary after procurement confirms template preference.
